_help: Copy to report-rules.json to change how report follow-ups are ranked and shown. weights: higher shows earlier (defaults in src/reports/learning.js). disabled: rule names, optionally prefixed with the report (scrum:, releases:, features:, prod:). collapseUnchanged: show repeats with unchanged facts as one line; alwaysShowScore: never collapse at or above this score. Jira data is never changed; this only affects ordering and visibility of the inferred follow-ups.
